subject.title: feat(skill-workshop): add restore action for quarantined proposals and display scan findings

question: Should an operator-admin rescan alone be allowed to move a still-non-clean proposal from quarantined to pending, or must content be revised before quarantine is cleared?
rationale: Both designs remain scanner-gated at apply time, but they give the quarantine state materially different security and operator meanings; code inspection cannot determine the intended product contract.

options.title: Keep quarantine until revision
options.body: Allow revision or guided chat repair while quarantined, rescan the changed bundle, and leave it quarantined until the approved exit condition is met.

options.title: Allow explicit restore
options.body: Permit an operator-admin restore to pending with findings retained, but document the semantics and prove that apply reliably succeeds or re-quarantines after the fresh scan.

recommendation.title: Keep quarantine until revision
recommendation.body: Allow revision or guided chat repair while quarantined, rescan the changed bundle, and leave it quarantined until the approved exit condition is met.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Skill Workshop security-boundary work makes this the strongest available owner for deciding what quarantine guarantees.
